children: Nvidia finished the day down 14%, dropping to the lowest level since May 2025 and bringing total losses since its Oct. 6 record to 47%.
The company has now lost roughly $2.7 trillion in market cap since its record, roughly the value of Amazon.com.
The shares closed lower for a seventh consecutive week, their longest losing streak since 2008.
